---
title: "simstim host alerts test"
---

<!-- Generated by `just docs` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Send a test alert to every destination now, and say what each did.

```text
simstim host alerts test <host> [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `--event <string>` | the kind of event to send, such as needs_input or failed (default: `test`) |

Part of [`host alerts`](host_alerts.md): show where a host sends alerts about its sessions, and the last deliveries.
